meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: Claude 会把解析好的结构化文档和你的意图，转成四张卡片：蓝卡（可溯源的事实）、绿卡（解释）、黄卡（风险与过度声明）、红卡（下一步行动），每张卡都带来源、可溯源。
howto.when: 当你提供了密卷房解析出的结构化文档（markdown）和查询意图时进入；通常由通政司主调用生成蓝卡、绿卡，黄卡与红卡再分别由监察院、丞相府复核补全。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档，先出蓝卡事实
say.note: 对应 extract 阶段，抽取带来源的事实卡

say.text: 跑一下 review 阶段，检查有没有过度声明
say.note: 对应 review，由监察院出黄卡风险

say.text: 用 propose 阶段给出下一步行动建议
say.note: 对应 propose，由丞相府补全红卡

howto.what_en: Claude turns a parsed document plus your intent into four cards: blue (facts with sources), green (explanation), yellow (risks and overclaiming), red (next-step actions). Each card carries sources and is traceable.
howto.when_en: Runs when a structured markdown document and a query intent are available; normally called by the Tongzhengsi worker for blue and green cards, while yellow and red cards are reviewed by Jichayuan and Chengxiangfu.

say_en.text: Analyze this document with four-color cards, blue facts first
say_en.note: Runs the extract stage for sourced fact cards

say_en.text: Run the review stage to check for overclaiming
say_en.note: Runs review; Jichayuan produces the yellow risk card

say_en.text: Run the propose stage for next-step actions
say_en.note: Runs propose; Chengxiangfu completes the red card
